arxiv-1711-04828.title: Evaluating deep variational autoencoders trained on pan-cancer gene expression
arxiv-1711-04828.creator: Gregory P. Way, Casey S. Greene
arxiv-1711-04828.description: Abstract Cancer is a heterogeneous disease with diverse molecular etiologies and outcomes. The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) has released a large compendium of over 10,000 tumors with RNA-seq gene expression measurements. Gene expression captures the diverse molecular profiles of tumors and can be interrogated to reveal differential pathway activations.

arxiv-2011-07399.creator: George M. Bergman
arxiv-2011-07399.description: Abstract . F. Wehrung has asked: Given a family 𝒞 \mathcal{C} of subsets of a set Ω , \Omega, under what conditions will there exist a total ordering on Ω \Omega with respect to which every member of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is convex?

arxiv-2107-13952.title: A high-performance code for EPRL spin foam amplitudes
arxiv-2107-13952.creator: Francesco Gozzini
arxiv-2107-13952.description: Abstract We present sl2cfoam-next , a high-performance software library for computing Lorentzian EPRL spin foam amplitudes. The library improves on previous codes by many orders of magnitude in single-core performance, can be parallelized on a large number of CPUs and on the GPU, and can be used interactively.

arxiv-2201-09213.title: FN-Net: Remove the Outliers by Filtering the Noise
arxiv-2201-09213.creator: Kai Lv
arxiv-2201-09213.description: Abstract Establishing the correspondence between two images is an important research direction of computer vision. When estimating the relationship between two images, it is often disturbed by outliers. In this paper, we propose a convolutional neural network that can filter the noise of outliers.

arxiv-2209-10358.title: Two-Nanorod PT Structure with Large Spontaneous Enhancement
arxiv-2209-10358.creator: Li, Zhichao
arxiv-2209-10358.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Li, Zhichao. Two-mode coupling is very common and basic in optics. Recently, a lot more works are focusing on the optical mode coupling with gain and loss due to its tighter link to actual world. For a couple between one gain and one loss mode, by adjusting the coupling constant, the mode in the spectrum will at first stay then move after the constant passing some critical point.

arxiv-2308-16002.title: Variations on the two-child problem
arxiv-2308-16002.creator: Christoph Börgers
arxiv-2308-16002.description: Abstract Departments of 1 Mathematics and 2 Psychology, Tufts University, Medford, MA Abstract. Mr. Smith has two children. Given that at least one of them is a boy, how likely is it that Mr. Smith has two boys? It’s a very standard puzzle in elementary books on probability theory.

arxiv-2312-09432.title: Radiation of anomalous energy
arxiv-2312-09432.creator: B. Ivlev
arxiv-2312-09432.description: Abstract In the Coulomb field of nucleus cut off on its size, besides usual atomic states, there are additional ones. These anomalous states are deep (in the range of 10 ​ M ​ e ​ V 10\,MeV ) in the Dirac sea and can exist solely during a macroscopic acceleration of the nucleus exceeding the certain level.

arxiv-2410-19106.title: Quantifying the Value of Revert Protection
arxiv-2410-19106.creator: Brian Z. Zhu, Xin Wan, Ciamac C. Moallemi, Dan Robinson, Brad Bachu
arxiv-2410-19106.description: Abstract Revert protection is a feature provided by some blockchain platforms that prevents users from incurring fees for failed transactions. We study the economic implications and benefits of revert protection in the context of priority gas auctions and maximal extractable value. We develop a model in which searchers bid for a top-of-block arbitrage opportunity under varying degrees of revert protection.

arxiv-2506-00953.title: TIGeR: T ext- I nstructed Ge neration and R efinement for Template-Free Hand-Object Interaction

arxiv-2506-00953.description: Abstract Pre-defined 3D object templates are widely used in 3D reconstruction of hand-object interactions. However, they often require substantial manual efforts to capture or source, and inherently restrict the adaptability of models to unconstrained interaction scenarios, e.g. , heavily-occluded objects.

pmc-12445256.title: Pre‐Transplant Diagnosis Asserts Significant Post‐Transplant Burden on Readmissions and Reinterventions: A Multicenter Study
pmc-12445256.creator: Mario O'Connor, Andrew Well, Hugo R. Martinez, Laura R. Norris, Bibhuti Das, Shriprasad R. Deshpande
pmc-12445256.description: PurposePre‐transplant (PreTX) diagnoses of congenital heart disease (CHD), including single ventricle (SV) CHD, are known to be associated with immediate post‐operative morbidity and mortality. However, the impact on post‐discharge health and morbidity has not been elucidated.MethodsThe Pediatric Health Information Survey (PHIS) data was used to identify patients undergoing orthotopic heart transplantation (HT).

pmc-12883746.title: Benefit finding in adults living with somatic non-communicable chronic disease: a systematic review on the mean level and the prevalence
pmc-12883746.creator: Zhunzhun Liu, Xiang Hu, Volker Arndt, Melissa S. Y. Thong
pmc-12883746.description: IntroductionBenefit finding (BF) refers to the phenomenon of identifying positive changes from challenging circumstances. This review aimed to comprehensively assess the BF prevalence in persons with somatic non-communicable chronic diseases (pSNCDs).Materials and methodsElectronic databases were systematically searched using the concept “benefit finding”.

pmc-13050949.title: The association between preoperative chronic pain and postoperative delirium in elderly patients undergoing elective orthopedic surgery
pmc-13050949.creator: Qianyu Yang, Jiawei Han, Lanyan Xue, Yanan Zhao, Lu Chen, Zixuan Wang, Jiayu Zhu, Xuesen Su, Shouyuan Tian
pmc-13050949.description: BackgroundPostoperative delirium (POD) is an acute and common postoperative complication that can increase morbidity and mortality. The evidence regarding the association between preoperative chronic pain and POD is inconsistent. This study aims to explore the relationship between preoperative chronic pain and POD.MethodsThis prospective cohort study consecutively enrolled 200 elderly patients undergoing elective orthopedic surgery.
